## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `c56051e5f5078ce552f1d9f064414c9c22248109`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #33215 body and all 4 comments (triage 6871974163, claim 6880221690, os-dev-report 6881339660, claim amendment 6881356522; no ruling on the card), PR #33354 body and file list (7 files, +365/-8), the net diff `fdb76fb8..c56051e5`, and the check-runs on this head. Face: declaration. No `packages/spec` path and no governed path in the diff; the review is owed by the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` line alone.

### ① Derived judgments

**Public surface, `@object-ui/components`** (`ui/packages/components/src/index.ts:78-90`): adds `useDisabledReason`, `DisabledReasonTrigger`, `DisabledReasonMenuLabel`, `menuItemReasonAria` and type `DisabledReason`, re-exported unchanged from the existing module `renderers/action/disabled-reason.tsx`. The only edit to that module is its header comment (the "module-private on purpose" paragraph is replaced). No signature changes. Nothing else in the entry is removed, renamed or narrowed. No name collides with an existing export (the `export *` barrels below hold no `DisabledReason*` / `menuItemReasonAria`). `describedByWithReason` stays module-private. Pure widening: **right**.

**`DataTableRowActionItem`** (`@object-ui/components`, `renderers/complex/data-table.tsx:665-688`): its props are unchanged, and so are its `disabled` verdict and fail direction (`fallback: true`, counted only behind `hasDeclaredPredicate`). It now adds `aria-labelledby` / `aria-describedby` and a second label line only when the declared `disabled` is true. An enabled item keeps its bare label, byte-for-byte as before (commit c56051e5). This is an additive presentation change. It refuses nothing new: **right**.

**`RowActionMenuItem`** (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `components/RowActionMenu.tsx:410-436`): same as above. The verdict is unchanged, and the reason is added only on a declared-true verdict: **right**.

**`RowActionInlineButton`** (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `components/RowActionMenu.tsx:540-564`): this is the behaviour change. The button used to ignore `disabled` and always dispatch. It now evaluates `disabled` with `useRowPredicate(def.disabled, row, { fallback: true, warnOnError: true, fields })`, counted only where `hasDeclaredPredicate` says a gate is declared. That is the same call as the "⋮" item beside it (line 411), and the same fail direction as the record header (`containers.tsx` passes `true` as the fallback for `disabled`). The button is newly refused in these cases:
- (a) A declared `disabled` that evaluates TRUE. The declaration is honoured. This is the card's fix: **right**.
- (b) A declared `disabled` that FAULTS, or cannot be evaluated yet (for example a `current_user.can(...)` gate before the permissions payload loads). The button is now disabled where it used to dispatch. This goes beyond (a), but it is the header's and the "⋮" item's own fail-closed posture (objectui#11242), the card's suggested fix shape asks for it, it is pinned in both new test files, and the changeset's inline bullet (line 13) discloses it: **right**, and disclosed.
- (c) An absent or blank `disabled`. `hasDeclaredPredicate` keeps the button enabled exactly as before, so nothing new is refused: **right**.

A disabled button is wrapped in `DisabledReasonTrigger`, a focusable `span`. The click container at `RowActionMenu.tsx:738` still stops propagation, so a click on the greyed button does not fall through to row navigation. Hooks are called before the `if (!isVisible) return null` early return. Built-in Edit / Delete `disabledWhen` keeps its fail-soft posture and is untouched. Spec accept set: none changed (`ActionSchema.disabled` / `disabledReason` are untouched and govern), so `Metadata-protocol: none` is **right**.

Findings:
- should-fix: `.changeset/33215-row-action-disabled-reason.md:8`. The sentence "Nothing that rendered before is refused." is contradicted by the same changeset's line 13 and by `RowActionMenu.tsx:554-556`. In the spec's own word for `disabled` ("shown but refused"), the inline row button IS newly refused: where the predicate is true (intended), and where it faults (fail-closed, beyond the true case). Reword it to say that nothing stops rendering and that the inline button is now refused where the declared `disabled` is true or faults. This does not change the Clause-② value or the semver level.
- nit: `RowActionMenu.tsx:410` reads `(def as any).disabled` while `:540` reads `def.disabled` for the same key. It is harmless (the `RowActionDef` index signature is `any`), but the two sibling reads now differ in spelling.
- nit: on a faulting predicate, the reason given is the action's declared `disabledReason` (pinned at `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.rowActionDisabled-33215.test.tsx`, fault case). That text can describe a state the row is not in. This mirrors the header's existing behaviour and is not new to this PR: observation, no carrier.

### ② Semver level

The changeset names `@object-ui/plugin-grid: patch` and `@object-ui/components: patch`. Those are the two published packages the diff moves. The other changed paths are two test files (`plugin-grid/src/__tests__`, `plugin-detail/src/__tests__`), so `plugin-detail` is not moved and is rightly unnamed. `patch` is right per AGENTS.md "Before finishing" §3: a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch`, and `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`. Not `skip-changeset`: correct, because the diff publishes.

Clause-②: yes (widening). The PR body and the changeset body both carry `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, each line-initial, and they agree with the diff: five new exports, nothing removed, no `(narrowing)` arm. Sentence by sentence against the diff:
- line 6 (inline button greys, every row surface gives its reason): matches.
- line 8: the export list matches. "Nothing that rendered before is refused" does not match; see the should-fix in ①.
- line 11 (`variant: 'primary'` renders as the inline button and ignored `disabled`): matches main at fdb76fb8.
- line 13 (same evaluator, fault disables, reason as `aria-describedby` plus tooltip, generic sentence fallback): matches `RowActionMenu.tsx:540-564` and `disabled-reason.tsx` `useDisabledReason`.
- line 14 (both "⋮" menus already greyed and now show the reason as a second line plus description): matches `data-table.tsx:665-688` and `RowActionMenu.tsx:415-436`.
- line 16 (the server still refuses): it is the card's own premise, not a claim this diff makes.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: `[]` in os-dev-report 6881339660. Nothing to answer.
- Dev flag, Clause-② measured `yes (widening)` against the claim's starting `no`: answered by claim amendment 6881356522. The amendment's export list, its "nothing removed or narrowed" and its added file surface (`components/src/index.ts`, `disabled-reason.tsx`, `data-table.tsx`) match the diff. The claim's "no `packages/spec` edit" is honoured.
- out_of_scope 1 (`containers.tsx`, app-shell `DeclaredActionsBar` and plugin-detail `record:quick_actions` keep their own reason wrappers): accepted as an observation with reach none. Converging them is a refactor, not a defect on this card. No carrier is owed.
- out_of_scope 2 (which related-list face the downstream probe hit is inferred): accepted. The card's evidence is a `button` whose `disabled` was false. Of the three faces, only the inline button was a button that failed to grey on main (both "⋮" items already greyed, and they are menu items shown only once the menu is opened), and the PR fixes it on the object list too. The missing reason was fixed on all three faces.
- security_findings `none`, dogfood battery n/a (no `!`, no narrowing arm): accepted.
- Gates, read from this head's check-runs (the dev's local 36-family run is not substituted for them):
  - Completed success: `Check Changeset` (run 43620337748), `PR-body guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check PR Size`, `Auto Label`, `filter`, `Build UI Deps`, `Plan Test UI shards`, `Live E2E UI`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`.
  - Skipped by path filter or opt-in: `UI Published Artifacts`, `Build Core`, `Build Docs`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Temporal Conformance`, `Packed-tarball smoke`, `18.x upgrade harness`, `Queue verdict`, `Borrowed queue verdict`, the matrix templates.
  - **Still running at review time, NOT read as green**: `Test UI (1/16)` to `(16/16)`, `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Type Check · workspace` / `source gates` / `consumer gates` / `debt ledger`, `Lint · ESLint` / `repo & tooling gates` / `CI, release & engine gates` / `docs & code guards` / `PM dispatch-gates` / `scoped · tooling self-tests` / `scoped · slot lookup & corpus` / `scoped · query-options erasure`, and a second `Check Changeset` (run 43620642222).
  - This verdict judges the contract only. Landing still waits on every running gate concluding green.

**VERDICT: PASS**
